case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Elenca i servizi in stato di errore in failed.tx
case.goal: Elenca i servizi in stato di errore in failed.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Step: enumerate services in a failed/error state.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `failed.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `failed.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.

executed_commands: Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Status, StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize
observed.note: failed.txt exists but contains no service names, only an empty header
